$comment: publicUtilities: classes shipped for consumers to pass through props (tableMinHeightClassName, tableMaxHeightClassName, boardMinHeightClassName). hookOnly: structural hooks (thead, tbody, icons, wrappers) the library writes on purpose without any default declaration, so consumers can target them; the audit checks they are emitted and never gain a rule silently. runtimeAttributes: data attributes set by Radix at runtime, never written in a component. hostAttributes: data attributes the host app sets to configure the library (theme activation).
